Notes

All time is 24-hour military time. The time of the crash/arrival of the emergency medical service can occur in a different day than the arrival of emergency medical service at the crash scene/hospital. If you need to separate day and night, see the data element LGT_COND under the heading Light Condition. This data element also appears in the Vehicle and Person data files and in the Parkwork data file as PHOUR.
